context.person: A person using a restaurant delivery application
context.user_goal: Track the new courier or contact support if the estimate changes again.

product_state.preceding_state: The original courier reported a bicycle problem and another courier accepted the pickup.
product_state.current_state: The restaurant still has the order. A new courier is assigned.
known_facts: The restaurant still has the order.
The estimated delivery moved from 7:10 PM to 7:25 PM.
The total and tip are unchanged.
forbidden_claims: The tip transferred to a different order.

current_content.title: An update
current_content.body: Open the app for more information.

challenge: Rewrite the mobile push notification so the person can understand order courier reassigned, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.secondary_action: Dismiss the update without changing the order.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Track the new courier or contact support if the estimate changes again.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
